author: Scout
details: Disable legacy Live CME depth requests and add distinct bounded zero-cost Historical depth identities with full native receipt evidence.
Separate native commodity quote entitlements and correct exchange-local intraday chart request dates.
Collect a bounded rotating options-book subset with truthful independent service scope and capacity evidence.
Reject synthetic and invalid market observations, invalidate prior derived context caches, and freeze unsupported optional coordinates using only base training rows.
Preserve existing source identities, per-PC model parameters and private configuration; new identities require explicit reviewed model admission.
limitations: Stacked on published PR205; no merge, peer installation or running-process adoption is claimed.
Historical depth may be delayed, empty, capacity-blocked or unavailable. Complete delivery means the bounded source response, not market-wide completeness.
Options-book subset collection remains partial; provider entitlement and runtime limits are independently evidenced.

Five existing optional account/adoption integration modules are absent from this older published base and are outside the tested broker-local provider/model path; the closure evidence names them explicitly.
Offline checks only; no private recipes, raw data, fitted models, provider probe evidence, orders or account details are published.
No main integration, peer installation or running-process adoption is claimed.
runtime_implications: Separate local review must migrate collection configuration and any new model selectors, refit under frozen settings, and install source. Publication does not start traders or change subscriptions.
scope: Shared source behavior; per-PC model choices, symbols and operating material remain local.
summary: Respect market-data plan transports and observed training support
